description: This file defines a class 'Image_Graph_Axis_Radar' for handling the axis in radar chart plots, specifically managing the drawing of radial axes for radar visualizations and extending category axis functionality.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Axis_Radar
classes.description: A class for managing radar plot axes, specifically radial axes mapping data points to angles in a radar chart, extending the Category axis class.

methods.name: _getMinimum
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of the axis, always 0 for radar axes.

methods.name: _getMaximum
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of the axis, based on the number of labels.

methods.name: _calcDelta
methods.description: Calculates the pixel difference (delta) per unit on the axis, specifically the angular step in degrees.

methods.name: _point
methods.description: Calculates the angular position in degrees on the radar circle for a given axis value.

methods.name: _size
methods.description: Returns the size of the axis; for radar axes, it is defined as always zero.

methods.name: setDistanceFromEnd
methods.description: Sets the pixel distance from the end of radial lines to the labels.

methods.name: _drawAxisLines
methods.description: Placeholder method for drawing axis lines; implementation details are not provided.

methods.name: _drawTick
methods.description: Outputs a tick mark on the axis at a given value, drawing radial lines and label positioning.
